taglineIntent: a members' running event: momentum, a shared start line and an open invitation to sign up
moodIntent: a weekend race members train for together; a clear route, a friendly start line and the feeling of the week before race day

components.name: Race distance card
components.role: compare the distances on offer and pick one
components.contentNotes: distance, start time, cut-off time, member price and one select action for each distance

components.name: Route overview
components.role: show the course and its checkpoints
components.contentNotes: a labelled course map, checkpoints with distance markers, and water stations

components.name: Race-day schedule
components.contentNotes: time, item and place for check-in, warm-up, start, finish and awards

components.name: Registration call-out
components.role: carry the one main registration action
components.contentNotes: registration deadline, the member benefit and the main action

dos: give every distance its own start time, cut-off time and member price
donts: leave the registration deadline as a countdown alone, because runners plan around a date
